xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
These results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved for issue by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 04 Feb, 2026. The statutory auditors have expressed an unmodified audit opinion on these results.
Hexaware Nevada, Inc was liquidated w.e.f 16 Oct, 2025 and Softcrylic Technologies Inc. was liquidated w.e.f 29 Oct, 2025
On 17 July 2025, the Company and its subsidiary Hexaware Technologies Inc. acquired 100% ownership of SMC Squared, LLC and its subsidiaries (“SMC”). This acquisition provides Hexaware with GCC expertise, ability to extend SMC’s offerings to Hexaware’s clients, and enhanced value by integrating SMC’s GCC capabilities with Hexaware’s strengths in AI, analytics, cloud transformation, modernization, and enterprise platforms. The collaboration combines SMC’s GCC expertise with Hexaware’s technology-led delivery to offer world-class GCC operations and attract top tech talent.
On 06 Nov 2025, the Company and its subsidiaries acquired 100% ownership of Identity And Access Solutions LLC, Identity And Access Solutions Canada, Inc., and IT Glitterz LLC (“CyberSolve”). This acquisition strengthens Hexaware’s AI-led Cybersecurity capabilities and entry into the expanding IAM market. It positions Hexaware as a cybersecurity partner with strong enterprise customers, enabling cross-sell and expansion opportunities.
In the US, Mobiquity Velocity Solutions Inc and Mobiquity Inc (wholly owned step-down subsidiaries) merged into Hexaware Technologies Inc (wholly owned subsidiary) effective 01 Jan 2026. On 06 Nov 2025, the Board gave in principle approval for the merger of Softcrylic LLC (Wholly owned subsidiary of the Company) into Hexaware Technologies Inc, subject to regulatory approvals.
In the Netherlands, Mobiquity Consulting BV merged into Mobiquity BV (Both wholly owned step-down subsidiary ) effective 01 Jan 2026. The Company received a no objection declaration from the Court of Amsterdam on 30 Jan 2026.
In India, the Company filed for the merger of Mobiquity Softech Private Limited and Softcrylic Technology Solutions India Private Limited into the Company on 20 Dec 2025, and is awaiting NCLT directions.
On 21 Nov 2025, the Government of India notified four Labour Codes consolidating twenty-nine labour laws into a unified framework governing employee benefits during employment and post-employment . The Ministry of Labour & Employment published draft Rules and FAQs to assess financial impact. The Group disclosed additional costs based on best information, presenting the impact as “Impact of new Labour Codes” under “Exceptional items” for the quarter and year ended 31 Dec 2025. The incremental impact includes INR 818 mn for gratuity and INR 293 mn for compensated absences, due to wage definition changes. The Group continues to monitor final Rules and will adjust accounting as needed.
For other notes, refer results submitted as part of Integral filing/Outcome of meeting
